messages.author: 62da3332a76a2586
messages.subject: Wishlist suggestions
parts:
Hi all,

First, let me just say that Shiny is amazing! I think it will be a real game changer in both teaching and reproducible research.

I built my own Shiny app in just a few hours:
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/smjenness/SIR/

Code at:
https://github.com/smjenness/Shiny/tree/master/SIR

I have a couple "wishlist" items for future development. I realize some of these may be currently modified through the tags functions, but I think many would find these tasks easier with function arguments.
1. a p(...) text field able to be placed under the headerPanel(...) in pageWithSidebar(...) pages. I would like to be able to move some of the text in my "About" tab to under the main page headerPanel.
2. dimension arguments (height, width) for the size of all input functions for the ui.R file, similar to those available for plotOutput(...). For example, in my app above, I would like to set the the width of the sliderInput for the linewidth function in the mainPanel, such that it would not span the entire width of the mainPanel. This would take the form, sliderInput(..., width=200px). 
3. relatedly, some of the input functions in the mainPanel get clipped, whereas there is more padding in the sidebarPanel. For example, slide my line width slide all the way to the left. Is there a padding argument that could be added to the sidebarPanel function?

Finally, I would love some sort of common repository of user examples, sort of like yihui's knitr showcase (http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/showcase/), since I learned everything based on the tutorial examples and digging through people's posts on this board.

Thank you!
Samuel Jenness
Department of Epidemiology
University of Washington

I just tried something Joe wrote in a post. I have a selectInput with multiple = TRUE. I wanted the box to be longer. The following works great from ui.R.

wellPanel(uiOutput("var"),tags$style(type='text/css', "#var { height: 400px;}"))
